title: Action — skateboard kickflip at a drained pool
useCase: Sports content, brand campaign, energetic social cut

anchor.subject: A skater in a mustard hoodie and black cap
anchor.scene: A drained concrete pool at golden hour, graffiti on the far wall
anchor.motion: Approach, pop, kickflip, land, ride out
anchor.camera: Low tracking shot at deck height that follows the board through the flip
anchor.audio: Wheels on concrete, the pop, a skateboard land, wind
anchor.light: Hard low golden-hour sun from camera-right, long shadows

seedance-2.0.prompt: A skater in a mustard hoodie and black cap rides toward the lip of a drained concrete pool at golden hour. He crouches, pops the tail, and the board rotates a full kickflip beneath him; his feet catch the grip tape and he lands clean, bending his knees to absorb before rolling away along the curved wall. Graffiti covers the far wall, and hard low sun from camera-right throws long shadows across the concrete. A low tracking camera at deck height follows the board through the flip and holds with him as he rides out. Warm golden grade, realistic wheel-on-concrete physics, natural body mechanics. Keep the hoodie and cap the same colour throughout, no duplicated skaters, no slow motion.
seedance-2.0.notes: Give the jump a four-beat structure: approach, pop, flip, land. Models drop the flip without the pop.

kling-3.0.prompt:
Scene: A drained concrete pool at golden hour, graffiti on the far wall, hard low sun from camera-right throwing long shadows.
Characters: A skater in a mustard hoodie and black cap, one person only.
Action: He approaches the pool lip, crouches, pops the tail, the board rotates a full kickflip, his feet catch the grip tape, he lands with bent knees and rides out along the curved wall.
Camera: Low tracking shot at deck height following the board through the flip and holding the ride-out.
Audio & Style: Wheels on concrete, a sharp pop, a solid landing, wind. Warm golden grade, realistic skate physics.
Negative: no slow motion, no duplicated skaters, no cut to another angle, no floaty gravity, no hoodie colour change, no text.
kling-3.0.notes: Forbid cuts. Kling tends to insert an angle change mid-action to hide physics errors.
